content: आस्तरण {%a.%} .²1 Spreading, covering. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Spreading, strewing. .²2 A bed, layer; कुसुम˚ a bed of flowers; क्रुसुमास्तरणे सहायतां बहुशः सौम्य गतस्त्वमावयोः <ls>Ku. 4. 35</ls>; सकुसुम˚ strewn with flowers <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; तमालपत्रास्तरणासु रन्तुम् <ls>R. 6. 64</ls>. .²3 A cushion, quilt, bed clothes; गत˚ without the bed clothes. .²4 A rug, carpet. .²5 An elephantʼs housings, painted cloth (thrown on his back). .²6 A layer of Kuśa grass spread out at a sacrifice. वेद आस्तरणं ब्रह्मोपबर्हणम् <ls>Av. 15. 3. 7</ls>.
